{{Quote|f we're lucky it'll be someone like Disk Moosea in that octofoil. He'll be satisfied with just throwing us a scare."<br />"And if we're unlucky?"<br />"If we're unlucky it'll be someone like Vor Childermoss!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="TPE" />}}
'''Vor Childermoss''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] leader of the [[Torgaigne]] crime syndicate, based off of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Attahox/Legends|Attahox]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Noted for being an especially hard, fearless and unforgiving taskmaster, Childermoss oversaw the Torgaigne's trade in [[phosovane salts]], used on many [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] as a base for [[Painkiller/Legends|painkillers]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Childermoss and his crew&mdash;which included his personal muscle, the hulking mute [[Leelu]]&mdash;pursued [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leader [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] into the nearby [[Hellhoop/Legends|Hellhoop]] after Solo was caught [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] phosovane salts on Attahox. There, Childermoss and his men were captured by the [[Five]], a reclusive evil-worshipping cult that lived within that region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. After Childermoss made the mistake of threatening the cultists, Five member [[Mavin]] utterly destroyed Childermoss and the rest of the Torgaigne with a [[black fireclaw]].<ref name="TPE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vor Childermoss appeared in ''[[The Pandora Effect]]'', a [[1981]] comic story written by [[Alan Moore]] and published in [[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 151|''The Empire Strikes Back Monthly'' 151]]. In the story, Childermoss was drawn by [[Adolfo Buylla]].<ref name="TPE" />
